text:
Zara: Heads-up team - webinar next Thurs 10am BST: "Inference in Production: latency, cost, and rollouts". Need a focused social plan: X microthread, LinkedIn post + employee advocacy play, and inbound routing for demo requests. Who can pick up pieces?

Ethan: I can own the X microthread + pin. Thinking 4 tweets: hook, one stat card, 2 takeaways + reg shortlink. Will propose two hooks (ops pain vs ROI).

Mina: Ill do LinkedIn and employee-adv copy. Employee toolkit request: 3 short captions, suggested hashtags, and image variants.

Caleb: Ill set up HubSpot gating + routing. Fields: name, company, job_title, company_size, utm, interest_area. Routing rule?

Jules: Design needs: stat card (1200x675), square GIF (600x600), vertical 9:16 clip for stories. Also a speaker quote overlay.

Zara: CTA priority: 1) Register (short form) 2) Watch recording 3) Book demo. UTM template: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium={platform}&utm_campaign=inference_prod_may.

Caleb: Propose routing: if job_title contains (SRE|ML|Platform|Infra) OR company_size >= 100 => hot -> assign SDRs
else => nurture. Also tag interest_area from form.

Mina: Employee advocacy plan: ask 20 engineers + PMs to post within 2 hours of our LI/X posts. Provide 3 captions: benchmark, ops, human story. Use #RedwoodInfra #Inference.

Ethan: X thread outline: Tweet1 Hook (short), Tweet2 stat card (internal benchmark + small caveat), Tweet3 micro-case, Tweet4 CTA + shortlink. Shortlink: rwd.in/infer (backup rwd.in/infer-wk).

Jules: Export tags: infer_stat_v1, infer_gif_v1, infer_vertical_v1. Will drop in #design-handoff by EOD.

Caleb: Routing pseudo for automation copy:
```
if job_title contains [SRE, ML, Platform, Infra] or company_size >=100:
  tag=hot
  assign=SDR_High
else:
  tag=nurture
  enroll=webinar_3_touch_seq
```

Mina: Employee copy snippets (short):
1) "We just ran an internal webinar on inference ops + cost. Recording + slides: <shortlink> #Inference #RedwoodInfra"
2) "How we cut tail latency in production — watch the demo + slides <shortlink>"
3) "Join our webinar on practical inference lessons for infra teams. Slides after. <shortlink>"

Ethan: A/B idea: Hook A = "Cut per-token cost by 2x with caching + batching (internal)" Hook B = "Stop chasing tail latency: tactical changes that work". Measure reg CTR.

Zara: Legal: include "internal benchmark" on stat card and link to methods doc. Mina plz add that to employee snippets.

Mina: Will add small qualifier: "(internal benchmark — results vary by workload)" on all stat mentions.

Jules: Will include qualifier in the stat card design.

Caleb: Post-live follow: create saved view webinar_top50_infer_may_2026. SDRs to outreach top 50 within 24h. Top 200 get recording + nurture.

Ethan: Who volunteers to monitor replies on X live? Need 2 - product + community. Mina can cover community; Jules can help with visuals.

Zara: Great. Owners recap: Ethan -> X thread + schedule; Mina -> LI + employee toolkit; Caleb -> HubSpot + routing; Jules -> design assets; Zara -> approvals + shortlinks. Deadline: copy by Tue 9am BST, assets in Figma by Tue EOD.

EmployeesBot: Kit created: employee_toolkit_infer_may_2026 (draft) -> /kits/employee_infer_may (will update when live).

Zara: Drop a :+1: if you can meet deadlines or flag blockers. Thanks all!
